system.description:
You become to those around you the all-knowing, all-protecting parent of early childhood - a faultless authority who commands almost blind devotion and trust.

Spend one Blood Trait to activate the power, which lasts the entire scene unless you turn it off. While active, everyone in the same area admires, respects and loves you as a significant authority; none will ever try to harm you, and all will attempt to cooperate. You can talk them into nearly anything within reason, though not the plainly suicidal. But if you obviously betray their trust, your "children" resent you and refuse to cooperate, and you cannot re-establish the influence for the rest of the session without using Forgetful Mind to erase the incident. Subjects remember the pleasant effect and may grow anxious in your absence.
